sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a little bluebird character. Draw this exact bird as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: the round body with its blue back and peach-pink chest, facing right as in image 1, without head, wings, tail or feet; its top, normally under the head, rounded.
2. the head: the round blue head with its cream cheek, facing right as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eye, no beak — keep the rosy cheek; its bottom edge rounded.
3. the folded wing: the near blue wing folded at rest, as it lies against the body in image 1, drawn whole, with a rounded shoulder.
4. the open wing: the same wing spread out as in flight, its feathers fanned, with a rounded shoulder.
5. the tail: the long blue tail feathers, with a rounded base.
6. one foot: a thin orange foot with its toes, with a short leg.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a little bluebird character; image 2 shows the same bird cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the bird's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the bird in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the bird's eye as it is in image 1: a big dark round eye with a white sparkle.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same eye sad: looking down, its upper lid tilted up towards the middle.
6. the beak as it is in image 1: open, chirping.
7. the beak closed.
8. the beak wide open, singing a long note.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.
